identity_and_program.finding: Purdue identifies the hall and residence-hall use; broad massing is recognizable.

horizontal_placement_and_footprint.finding: GIS polygon and plinth AABB bounds agree below 0.0001 m in the documented approximate local frame; not survey control or full wall-shape proof.

massing_and_height.finding: Two tall wings and lower connector are legible; overall height, floor spacing, and roof profile remain unverified.

facade_and_openings.finding: Brick and repeated vertical window strips are plausible, but cadence, blank areas, screen placement, and entrance distribution lack direction-identified elevation evidence.

materials_site_and_presentation.finding: R2 fixes lawn/drive material categories using qualitative shaders; hero presentation remains flat with gray world and limited ground detail.

interior_and_circulation.finding: Interior objects are explicitly unverified opaque shells; no verified rooms, circulation, bathrooms, or stairs are represented.

technical_integrity_and_handoff.finding: R2 reopen validation passes, image dependencies are packed, no unresolved unpacked images, and diagnostic overlay is hidden from render.

scoring_method: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of seven categories, rounded to one decimal; reviewer judgments, not measured accuracy.
